credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue growth accelerated from 10.0% YoY in Sep 2025 to 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026, matching management's narrative of strong momentum.
Consolidated EBITDA reached Rs 56,616 crores in Sep 2026, supporting claims of strong profitability expansion.
Despite claims of rapid scaling, new energy capacity targets for solar and batteries have been repeatedly deferred.

bull: Consolidated revenue growth accelerated strongly to 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026.
Operating cash flow reached Rs 192,113 crores for the year ended Mar 2026.
Consolidated PAT reached Rs 29,550 crores in Sep 2026, up 33.8% YoY.
bear: Borrowings increased to Rs 405,322 crores as of Sep 2026.
Cash cycle stretched by 28 days over two years from -3 to 25.
Missed initial deadlines for 20-gigawatt solar and 40-gigawatt hour battery capacity.
watch: Solar module capacity progress toward 20 gigawatt target
FMCG revenue trajectory toward the Rs 1 lakh Crore FY2030 goal
